notes: Pete Trick Or Pete is a Halloween-themed Pete the Cat book. Vocabulary is centred on Halloween traditions: trick-or-treating, costumes, and collecting candy. 'Trick or treat' is included as a single fringe slot given its central importance to the story and Halloween theme; the teacher may wish to use a composite icon or a speech-bubble style symbol. 'Scary' is included as a key descriptive word children will use to react to costumes and situations in the book. 'Cat' is included as a fringe word because Pete is a cat and students may use it to label or comment on the character independently of the hero slot. If the library contains a Halloween-specific bag or treat bucket icon, prefer that over a generic bag symbol.
